title: Paper bag: free fall rejected
description: A crumpled paper bag thrown across the frame, filmed at 200 fps. Of three drag laws, only drag proportional to speed forecasts the held-out flight (2.9% error; quadratic drag forecasts 5.9% and is 57 BIC worse): k = 2.42 per second (95%: 2.32 to 2.52). No ruler is in view, so lengths are set by assuming Earth's gravity, and the result says so.
credit: Video: Rhetos / Mathe-AC Lernwerkstatt Aachen, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0 (20x slow-motion part, trimmed and re-encoded)
